verdict.rationale: Lever is a SaaS applicant-tracking platform, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents only a REST Data API, OAuth, webhooks and an integrator sandbox, and never mentions an MCP server. Those API primitives are developer building blocks, not an official MCP server, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
